Pretzel dough proved, shaped into knots, dipped in hot bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, mustard to dip.
M: the lasagne Veronica brings to the store
Beef ragù simmered 2 hours with tomato and red wine, layered with lasagne sheets, ricotta and mozzarella, baked at 180C for 45 minutes and rested 20 before cutting.
Long rolls loaded with salami, ham, provolone, shredded lettuce, tomato, onion, oil, vinegar and oregano, wrapped tight and cut in half.

s.note: the customer checking every carton for a perfect dozen
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a dash of vinegar. Pipe back into the whites, dust with paprika and add chives. Exactly twelve.
Tip 100g beef jerky, 150g salted peanuts, a bag of potato chips and 200g sour lollies into bowls and line them up along the bench like the shop counter. I'm not even supposed to be here today.

m.how: Split 4 long bread rolls. Layer with 150g salami, 150g ham, 100g provolone, shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and onion. Drizzle with olive oil and red wine vinegar, sprinkle with oregano, wrap tight and cut in half.

w.note: the shelves Dante never stops restocking
w.how: Chill 8 cream-filled sponge snack cakes and 4 chocolate cupcakes for 30 minutes. Stack them on a plate in neat rows like the shop shelf, still in their wrappers if you want the full Quick Stop experience.

d.note: the milk fridge at the back of the store
d.how: For each glass, shake 250ml cold milk with 1 tbsp cocoa, 1 tbsp malted milk powder and a few ice cubes until frothy. Or just drink the milk cold straight from the carton.
